reviews.text: I can’t begin to express how grateful we are to LA Pet Sitting and especially our amazing petsitter Gabriella. When we leave town we don’t have to worry about our fur babies, we know they are in incredible hands. Gabriella goes above and beyond to make sure our kitties are happy and well taken care of. She truly has been such a gift and makes traveling with peace of mind possible for our family.

Michael did such a great job looking after our kitties for our trip. We were gone a full week and he checked in with us everyday with photos so I knew they were safe. You can tell he really cares about their wellbeing and it was such a relief to have them be well cared for while we were away. Brooke from LA Pet Sitting was extremely helpful and booking was really easy. I highly recommend using them for your next get away. 🐾❤️

They were the only pet sitters that fit our building access criteria: a consistent sitter name and image we could pre-register with the front desk for key access. Thank goodness so far we've been matched with excellent pet sitters who know our area (DTLA), and who our cat could cozy up to in a short amount of time! Special shout out to Frank and Karina. They added adorable photos of our cat happily rolling around in their daily "pet status reports".

Liz is an absolute gem! She takes amazing care of my cats while I’m away, ensuring they are not only well-fed and cared for but also showered with love and attention. It’s such a relief to know they’re in good hands, and her thoughtful updates and adorable photos always put my mind at ease. Her reliability, kindness, and genuine love for animals are unmatched. I highly recommend Liz and LA Pet Sitting to anyone looking for a trustworthy and attentive pet sitter—you and your pets will be so glad you found her!
Our cat sitter, Paw, was great. She really made us feel comfortable and safe. Everything was easy and our pets were happy!
Wonderful! I've used them a bunch of times. Totally flexible and highly communicative.  They send the cutest pictures of our fur babes so we are comfortable while we are out and about.
Our pet sitter Stephen was great! We were gone over Christmas and New Year's and everything went well for our two cats AND our fish!

We had the BEST experience with LA Pet Sitters! Thank you so much to Brooke and Julia for taking the most incredible care of our two high maintenance kitties. Julia is the best cat sitter we have ever had. Our cats loved her and I could tell how much she loved them and cared for them as if they were her own babies. They require special care including medication and being separated while we are away and everything was handled with such ease. From communication to following instructions and leaving our place so clean, the entire experience was amazing. We had such piece of mind knowing our kitties were so well taken care of and are so grateful to have found our new favorite pet sitter! ❤️
